description: Experiment E10's first pass (docs/experiments/e10-generated-props.md): twenty Desert Survival props (docs/plan/13-reference-consumer-games.md, Consumer A), general-audience, no people and no creatures beyond bones. Each subject is the noun phrase the image template wraps (tools/generate.ps1, template image-to-3d/1); category and size_m are what a later scale validator (07 §7.4) will check a mesh against, recorded now so the list does not have to be written twice; budget names the subject's class in triangle_budgets, the polycount the second pass asked Meshy to remesh to.

triangle_budgets.why: E10 pass 2 (docs/experiments/e10-generated-props.md, 'Pass 2'): the triangle count a generator is asked to remesh each subject to, by the subject's budget class. All three sit at or under the harness's -DenseTriangles line of 250,000, above which a picture-error failure is diagnosed as detail carried by geometry. The cluster LOD makes source density a disk and build cost rather than a frame cost, so a budget is about what the coarse cut can still represent, not about the finest cut. The same three numbers were used for the owner's Tripo run by hand, so the two services are compared at one budget. tools/generate.ps1 3d -Backend meshy -Remesh -Subjects <this file> takes the polycount from here.
